headline: Cowboys To Activate Tyler Smith From IR
summary: Tyler Smith returned to practice earlier this week. The Cowboys’ best offensive lineman will now be eligible to play as early as tonight. Smith is being activated from injured reserve, NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports. He had his practice window opened on Monday, giving the Cowboys 21 days to bring him back onto the active roster. headline: Sean Payton will resume calling offensive plays for Broncos
summary: With the Seahawks looming, Payton will get his play-calling sea legs against the Chargers.

headline: Texans HC DeMeco Ryans Reclaims Defensive Play-Calling Duties
summary: Sitting at 0-4, the Texans are not making a coaching change. A shift in responsibilities will be taking place along the sidelines, however. Head coach DeMeco Ryans announced on Wednesday that he is taking over defensive play-calling responsibilities. headline: Jayden Daniels On Track To Return In Week 5; Marcus Mariota Sprains MCL
summary: After missing back-to-back games with a dislocated left elbow, Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels is trending toward returning in Week 5. headline: Buccaneers S Antoine Winfield To Miss Time
summary: Buccaneers safety Antoine Winfield is expected to miss two to four weeks with a rib fracture, head coach Todd Bowles said on Monday (via senior team writer Scott Smith).
